notes.note: native-platform-boundary.mjs's lexer now decodes TOML 1.1 \xHH and whitespace-before-newline continuations, refuses escapes TOML does not define, and ends JSON5 comments and continuations at every line terminator; the document's least-privilege claims still hold.

Added that publish-release runs its policy from the default branch, so republishing or a break-glass pointer repair for a tag signed before the version-binding rule is refused at the assemble step before any upload, and rebuilding such a tag reuses its own older signing script.
